audit.why: Early lane favours Malzahar (melee Kassadin cannot contest Visions harass), scales toward Kassadin at 2+ items with Riftwalk stacks. Prose reflects this correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content chart and the packet on 6 of 7 rows (e.g. full said Kassadin wins 2+ items, content and packet say Skill).
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content win[] agree exactly (Malzahar, Skill, Skill, Malzahar, Malzahar, Malzahar, Skill); full phases[].side was the outlier. Moved full sides to match, rewrote the whys to agree with the new verdicts.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and named a fabricated passive 'Iron Boundary' (Malzahar's passive is Void Shift). Nether Blade (W) auto-reset tell was missing from the page.
audit.why: Kit gives Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s, Null Sphere 9-7s, Force Pulse 21-17s, Malzahar R 140/110/80s. W is flagged autoReset — the wind-up is the step-back cue. The brief's missing-interaction claiming Null Sphere is an interruptible channel contradicts Riot's own text (Q INTERRUPTS channels, it is not one) — flag misfire, not written to the page.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns; W reset tell added to report[5]; fabricated passive name removed.

edits.before: E a caster minion and let the visions farm for you — your lane is a macro pattern, not a duel, from the first wave.
edits.after: Kassadin is melee with no shield yet — E a caster minion, then chunk him every time he walks up. Level 1 is free harass.

edits.before: Q online: the silence is your trade answer. Use it on his engage spell, not on poke he can walk around.
edits.after: His Null Sphere shield-silence is online and blunts your poke — trade only after he burns its 9s cooldown.

edits.before: W voidlings turn your shove permanent — the wave hits his tower while you ward, roam-shadow, or just exist safely.
edits.after: His Q-shield answers your harass while your voidlings shove — both sides farm; bait the 9s shield before committing E.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: His stacked Riftwalk resets every 2s and dodges fights, but one landed suppression still wins a teamfight — even on execution.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Check it before every step-up. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 but 2s at rank 3 — his all-in window shrinks while yours stays flat. - Force Pulse (E) runs 21-17s and needs nearby casts to charge; when it is down he cannot slow your retreat. - Your R is 140s early: spend it on his commit, never on waves.

edits.before: Kassadin wins by landing Riftwalk, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Kassadin wins by surviving to Riftwalk stacks — at 2s cooldown he blinks past your zone control and bursts you before Q even fires.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Hold Call of the Void for the moment he Riftwalks in — the silence cuts his Force Pulse and Nether Blade follow-up, turning his all-in into a wasted blink.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: With Void Shift on cooldown and Nether Grasp spent, his 2s Riftwalk turns plate greed into a free kill — back off until one is up.

edits.before: Track Kassadin’s Riftwalk: His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Nether Blade (W) is an auto reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your step-back cue. Your point-and-click R still locks him mid-Riftwalk.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport standard — TP doubles your shove-tax map game. Ghost-cleanse setups exist into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport standard — TP returns you to lane without losing the shove. Ghost-cleanse exists into hard dive; Ignite pairs with R kill threats if you want lane blood.

notes: Full-layer chart was the outlier against packet + content on 6 rows; moved full sides to the packet/content verdict (win[N] already matched the targets, so side edits stand alone per the chart rule). Fabricated passive name 'Iron Boundary' removed from breakdown.cooldowns (Malzahar's passive is Void Shift). The brief's missing-interaction 'Null Sphere is a channel your R cancels' is a flag misfire — Riot's text says Q interrupts channels, it is not itself one — so it was not written to the page. All four lintFindings fixed.
